practice.title: Take an Interview: 4 preguntas
practice.intro: Escucha la pregunta (puedes repetirla) y responde en **45 segundos** con la plantilla PREP. Graba, escucha tu grabación y compara con el modelo.

questions.q: What are the most important qualities of a good teacher?

segments.text: What are the most important qualities of a good teacher?

questions.model: I think the most important quality is patience, because students learn at different speeds. For example, my math teacher in high school explained the same idea in three different ways until everyone understood. That kind of patience makes students confident enough to ask questions.

questions.q: How do you decide whether to buy something or save your money?

segments.text: How do you decide whether to buy something or save your money?

questions.model: I usually ask myself whether I will use it regularly. If the answer is yes, I buy it; otherwise, I save the money. For instance, I wanted a new tablet last year, but I waited two months to be sure, and in the end I realized my laptop was enough.

questions.q: Do you think living in a dormitory or in an apartment is better for students?

segments.text: Do you think living in a dormitory or in an apartment is better for students?

questions.model: I think a dormitory is better in the first year because it helps you make friends quickly. For example, I met most of my classmates in the dorm kitchen. Later, an apartment gives more privacy and quiet for studying.

questions.q: Tell me about a place in your hometown that you would recommend to visitors.

segments.text: Tell me about a place in your hometown that you would recommend to visitors.

questions.model: I would recommend the old market near the river, because it shows local culture and food. For example, you can try fresh fruit juices and watch artists selling handmade crafts. It is also free, which makes it perfect for visitors on a budget.
